name: Clean Launcher
desc: Perfect launch: Power x1.10 for the race.

name: Shift Savant
desc: Each Perfect shift: +3% Power for the rest of the race.

name: Double Clutch
desc: Each Perfect shift: Gearing x1.05, compounding.

name: Redline Gambler
desc: Perfect window 40% narrower. Perfect shifts give Power x1.25 for that gear.

name: Boost Brain
desc: Forced induction and nitrous parts count 50% stronger.

name: Garage Rat
desc: +2% Power per slot with a non-Stock part.

name: Cash Cow
desc: Earn $2 per Perfect grade in a race.

name: Finish Line Flair
desc: Win by less than 0.1 s: earn $5.
